page.notes: The running head is printed in spaced capitals. The lines "Ad quam speciem..." and "Sùntne plures..." are set in a larger, centred type; they are questions in the text, so I wrote them as paragraphs, not headings. Doubtful readings: "dominum:item" (the colon and the ligature are unclear). The Greek-style "e" in "e sublimi" may be "è" in print. Marginal references "Lib.2." and "cap.7." are printed beside the same paragraph and are kept as two notes.
